Q36 is stable over 40 repeats or classified with the reason
The classifier and the promotion gate fail or flag a cell that differs between repeated runs
description: Q36 on the expression family at SF 0.03 diverges in some runs of identical code (40 repeats in one process: 2 divergent without the #2502 changes, 1 with them; detail: Value mismatch at row 4, column 3. Original: 0, Variant: 1). Q36 uses none of the changed code. Find the cause (likely a tie or an unstable aggregation order). A cell that flips between runs cannot be a stable gate, so the classifier (t14) and the promotion gate (t20) need repeat-run detection.
